headline: Ukraine begins introducing mandatory declaration of mobile phone IMEI numbers on import
summary: Ukraine is beginning to introduce mandatory declaration of mobile phone IMEI numbers on import, after the Ministry of Finance signed the relevant order, according to Citrus CEO Artem Shevchenko.
why: Import rules for consumer electronics affect device importers, retailers and mobile operators, and shape the cost and compliance burden of bringing phones into a market.
